faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: MOQ, samples, lead times and customization questions answered.
faq.content:
BUYER QUESTIONS

A clear start
to your project.

Answers to the questions we hear at the start of a private-label program.

What is your minimum order quantity?+

Our MOQ is 300 pieces per style, per color, across up to 4 sizes.

How much do samples cost?+

Samples start at US$15. Custom development, additional versions and shipping are quoted separately for your project.

How long does sampling and production take?+

Sampling starts at 7 days and regular production at 15 days. Timing depends on approved specifications, materials, quantity and the production schedule. Your quotation confirms the schedule.

Can you customize both underwear and socks?+

Yes. We operate an underwear factory and a sock factory. We coordinate specifications, branding and packaging for both product categories.

Can I use my own design and logo?+

Yes. Send your artwork, measurements or reference sample. We review the construction, fabric, waistband or sock branding, and packaging before sampling.

Do you ship to the United States and Europe?+

Tell us your destination and requested delivery date. Shipping terms, freight costs and customs responsibilities will be confirmed in your quotation.

Can you share compliance documents?+

Request the documents required for your market and product. We will provide the relevant available documentation for review against your order specifications.

How do I send a tech pack?+

Email your tech pack and artwork to sales@wugan.net, or start with the project inquiry form. Include the style, fabric, quantity, destination and target launch date.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How WUGAN handles product inquiries and contact information.
privacy.content:
WUGAN

Privacy policy

Information submitted through this website is used to respond to your product inquiry.

Information you provide

When you contact us, we receive your name, email address, company, country and project requirements. Please send only information needed to discuss your project.

How we use it

We use inquiry information to respond, prepare quotations, discuss samples and manage your project. Inquiry records are available to authorized staff and our website and email service providers as needed for these purposes.

Retention and your choices

You may request access, correction or deletion of your inquiry information by contacting sales@wugan.net. We retain records as needed to respond and meet applicable business and legal obligations.

Cookies and external services

Essential website functions may use cookies. Links to WhatsApp open an external service governed by its own privacy policy. This theme does not include advertising trackers by default.

Contact

Email sales@wugan.net for privacy inquiries.

brand-development.description: Development routes for established brands, emerging labels and coordinated underwear and sock collections.
brand-development.content:
BRAND DEVELOPMENT

Build on what
makes your brand different.

Bring your market position and product requirements. We help translate them into a sampling and production brief.

01 / ESTABLISHED BRANDS

Develop from your technical pack

Share your measurement chart, fabric requirements, graded sizes, artwork and construction details. Flag the problems you want to solve in your current product.

02 / EMERGING LABELS

Start with a considered range

Select one or two base silhouettes. Define the target customer, retail positioning and budget before investing in multiple colors or complex development.

03 / COORDINATED PROGRAMS

Add socks to the collection

Review underwear and sock specifications separately, then align logos, color direction and packaging. Confirm quantities and schedules for each category.

What makes a useful first brief?

01 / Product reference or technical pack

02 / Target customer and market

03 / Fabric, fit and construction priorities

04 / Quantity per style, color and size

05 / Target price range, if available

06 / Launch date and delivery destination

quality-assurance.title: Quality Control & Supplier Documentation | WUGAN
quality-assurance.description: Review sample approval, inspection requirements and applicable supplier documentation.
quality-assurance.content:
QUALITY & DOCUMENTATION

Confidence starts
with a defined standard.

A production order needs more than a product photo. Agree on the specification, approval reference and inspection requirements before manufacturing.

01

Before production

Confirm composition, weight, measurements, tolerances, color reference, artwork and packaging. Keep the approved sample and specification aligned.

02

During production

Review cutting, construction and finishing requirements with the team. Identify critical points such as waistband dimensions, seam placement and pouch shape.

03

Before shipment

Agree on finished-product inspection criteria, labeling and packaging checks. Tell us whether your project requires an independent inspection.

SUPPLIER DUE DILIGENCE

Ask for the evidence
your project needs.

Supplier assessment

An Intertek supplier assessment report for Zhongshan Wugan Clothing Co., Ltd. is available for review. Ask for the relevant assessment scope and latest information.

Social compliance / BSCI

Request the factory audit report and confirm the assessed site, findings and current status for your sourcing requirements.

Material documentation / OEKO-TEX

Documentation applies to specific holders and material scopes. Request current documents for the fabric selected for your order.

Request supplier documents ↗
